hypothesis: Can a recall-first union of five lexical and five dense message candidates retain the needed evidence inside 16k, 70k and 250k-token conversations while returning at most ten exact messages for one-at-a-time reading?
source_payload: the same immutable Codex visible-message inventory used by Gate 16E.1

index_contract.unit: one complete visible user or assistant message
index_contract.storage: persist vectors locally with source snapshot and exact message coordinates
index_contract.union_order: best reciprocal rank, then exact message ID
index_contract.reader_contract: inspect one candidate at a time; no concatenated mega-prompt
